props.reason: Makar is one of the league's premier offensive defensemen and quarterbacks Colorado's top power-play unit at home. His elite assist rate makes clearing a half-assist line highly probable despite the short price.

Pastrnak is a perennial 40+ goal scorer and Boston's primary shooting threat, giving strong value at plus-money against a rebuilding Anaheim defense. His shot volume and power-play usage support a consistent anytime-goal price.

McAvoy leads Boston's defense in ice time and power-play quarterbacking, giving him ample opportunity to log a single assist. Facing a less experienced Ducks squad, plus-money on a near coin-flip prop offers solid value.

Lehkonen is a high-volume shooter in Colorado's top-six, consistently getting multiple shot attempts per game. His usage against a Pittsburgh team still sorting out defensive structure supports clearing this shots line.

Rust is a shoot-first winger who regularly challenges 3+ shots in a game, and the plus-money here on the higher shots line offers good value. Colorado's blue line reshuffling could open additional looks for Pittsburgh's forwards.

Gauthier has emerged as Anaheim's primary shot generator, often leading the team in attempts per game. Near-even odds on a high shots total reflect his aggressive offensive role in a young, pace-driven Ducks lineup.

Sennecke has been given significant top-six minutes and is trusted to shoot the puck frequently as a developing offensive piece for Anaheim. The even-money line is reasonable given his growing shot volume this season.
